genxml.title: Hub block transfer engine registers and control bits outside the census

struct.name: IIO_WID
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header (Linux 7.2-rc7): IIO_WID and hubii_wid_u
struct.doc: Widget identification register of the Hub widget. Offset and field layout are from the public header. The header gives no access type and no reset value, so the reset is unknown.

struct.name: IIO_ILAPR
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header (Linux 7.2-rc7): IIO_ILAPR
struct.doc: Local access protection register, named and placed by the public header. The header gives no fields, access type or reset. Access is assumed read and write.

struct.name: IIO_ILAPO
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header (Linux 7.2-rc7): IIO_ILAPO
struct.doc: Protection override register, named and placed by the public header. The header gives no unlock value or behaviour, so none is imported. Access is assumed write only.

struct.name: IIO_ITTE
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header (Linux 7.2-rc7): IIO_NUM_ITTES, IIO_ITTE_BASE, IIO_ITTE
struct.doc: Big-window translation entry n, for n from 0 to 6. Entry 0 is at the register offset and each later entry is eight bytes further on. Access is an assumption. Reset is unknown.

struct.name: IIO_IBNA_0
struct.doc: Notification address of engine 0, the twin of the engine 1 slot in the census. Offset and name are from the public header. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.

struct.name: IIO_IBIA_0
struct.doc: Interrupt address of engine 0. Offset and name are from the public header. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.

struct.name: IIO_IBIA_1
struct.doc: Interrupt address of engine 1. Offset and name are from the public header. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.
